level_reason: Platform-independent search and evaluation code. Local checks and independent review. Three-platform compatibility is deferred to the next integration milestone and is not claimed.

revisions.reference_checkpoint: a01eb633: new engine with the earlier search and evaluation still in the tree
revisions.tested: 6fef75d1: final revision with the review corrections; the acceptance results below are from this revision
revisions.before_review: ec6dcda8: earlier search removed; its results are kept in ec6dcda8/ (bench 1,365,068 nps, blunders 87 of 146, match +55 -1 =4)

checks.name: linter
checks.result: passed: no warning from project code

checks.name: evaluation equality with the earlier evaluation
checks.result: passed: each term, phase, specialized ending and final score equal on more than 8000 positions from random legal games and special endings. The test left the tree with the earlier evaluation in ec6dcda8.

checks.name: perft and native-rules comparison
checks.result: passed: six published perft positions; random walks over more than 3000 positions compare legal moves, resulting boards, hash, incremental state, check status and pseudo-legality with the native rules; the no-change legality check used by the fifty-move claim agrees with make on each quiet piece move

checks.name: deep perft
checks.result: passed: start position depth 6 (119,060,324) and five other published positions at depth 5 to 7

checks.name: speed benchmark
checks.result: median 1,380,211 nodes per second (baseline 296,656); total 857,606 nodes for the fixed depths (baseline 5,431,097); median time to depth 0.62 s

checks.name: depth at five seconds
checks.command: go movetime 5000 on five positions, new game before each
checks.result: depth 16, 15, 14 in three opening or middlegame positions; depth 20 and 24 in two endgames. The earlier engine had a median depth of 8 to 9 at five seconds in the MSH-161 games.

checks.name: blunder suite at 1000 ms
checks.result: avoided 85 of 146 (baseline 47); matched reference 40 (baseline 17). Endgame 24 of 47, middlegame 49 of 83, opening 12 of 16.
checks.note: Exposed development positions. Avoided means only that the engine did not play the confirmed error.

checks.name: game test against the frozen predecessor
checks.result: SPRT decision H1 at 30 pairs: 55 wins, 0 losses, 5 draws in 60 games at 200 ms per move; Elo estimate +545 with lower bound +385; no failed pair; 143 s wall, 1060 s CPU
checks.note: Self-play against the predecessor on one machine with exposed openings. It is not a rating and not a result against other engines.

not_run: Linux and Windows builds or tests

independent_review.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 subagent, fresh context, read-only, on b5758a28..ec6dcda8

findings.finding: The engine server and desktop path start a new coordinator and engine for each request, so the table is not kept between moves there.
findings.disposition: Not changed in this task: the one-shot engine process is the execution contract of that path. Recorded as MSH-169 (Engine Session Persistence). Acceptance criterion 2 is met on the UCI path only; owner decision requested.

findings.finding: A table cutoff ignored the claimable-draw lower bound.
Futility-pruned moves did not raise the stored upper bound.
An exact quiescence result replaced a deeper entry of the same search.
No move is returned when a search stops before depth 1 completes.
findings.disposition: No change: this is the existing incomplete-result contract of the engine protocol, and tests assert it. Depth 1 needs about 30 nodes.

findings.finding: The fifty-move claim test copied the full position at each node with halfmove 99.
findings.disposition: Corrected in 6fef75d1: legality check without a change of the position, compared with make in the random-walk test.

findings.finding: Move flags above 7 were not rejected.
findings.disposition: Corrected in 6fef75d1; the random pseudo-legality test now uses all 16-bit encodings.

findings.finding: A large Hash value is allocated at the start of the next request, outside the time budget.
findings.disposition: Not changed; recorded as a known limit.

independent_review.re_review: Not done. The corrections are covered by the tests named above and by the repeated acceptance checks.

open_owner_decision: Acceptance criterion 2 says that the table is kept between moves of one game. That is true on the UCI path and not on the desktop one-shot process path (MSH-169).
